youtube.aciklama: According to a 2006 study by Mehta and colleagues, hearing loss from a perforation is greatest at low frequencies and grows with the size of the hole. A smaller middle ear and mastoid air volume makes the same hole cause more loss; contrary to popular belief, the location of the hole did not markedly affect the loss.
